title: Legendary Maces Plus
description: This plugin adds 9 custom maces to your server each with custom abilities and recipes.
body:
⚔ Legendary Maces Plus
( scroll down for recipes )
Legendary Maces adds 9 powerful legendary maces with unique smash abilities, cooldowns, one-time crafting, and server-wide announcements.

🗡️ Maces

⚡ Thunder Mace

- Lightning strike on smash
- Bonus area damage
- Cooldown: 10s

🔥 Flame Mace

- Ignites enemies for 5 seconds
- Grants Fire Resistance to the wielder
- Cooldown: 8s

❄️ Frost Mace

- Applies Slowness II for 4 seconds
- Reduces jump height
- Cooldown: 8s

⛈️ Storm Mace

- Powerful knockback burst
- Grants Speed I
- Cooldown: 12s

🌑 Shadow Mace

- Applies Blindness
- Grants temporary Invisibility
- Cooldown: 15s

☠️ Doom Mace

- Applies Wither II
- Chance to weaken enemies
- Cooldown: 15s

🕳️ Void Mace

- Launches enemies upward
- Applies Levitation
- Cooldown: 12s

🌋 Inferno Mace

- Small non-destructive explosion
- Creates a ring of fire
- Cooldown: 18s

✦ God Mace

Contains the powers of all eight legendary maces.
Cooldown: 20s.

🔨 Features

✅ Custom smash abilities

✅ Cooldown system with action bar feedback

✅ One-time crafting for every mace

✅ Server-wide broadcast and sound effect when crafted

✅ Individual recipe enable/disable commands

✅ Persistent data across restarts

✅ Works on players and mobs

📜 Commands

/givemace <mace> [player]

Gives a legendary mace.

Permission:
"legendarymaces.give"

Alias:
"/gm"

/legendarymaces recipe enable <mace>

Enables a recipe.

/legendarymaces recipe disable <mace>

Disables a recipe.

/legendarymaces recipe status

Displays recipe and craft status.

Permission:
"legendarymaces.admin"

Alias:
"/lm"

Mace names:

- thunder
- flame
- frost
- storm
- shadow
- doom
- void
- inferno
- god

Cooldown bypass permission

"legendarymaces.bypass.cooldown"

🔐 Permissions

Permission| Description
legendarymaces.give| Allows giving maces
legendarymaces.admin| Allows admin commands
legendarymaces.bypass.cooldown| Ignores ability cooldowns
